k:HH.Ins.Neg.RiskHard: Harder levels: a third failed round can make them cancel your policy.
k:HH.Ins.Cancel.Title: Cancel policy
k:HH.Ins.Cancel.When: The cancellation takes effect in about {0} days: at the next quadrum change at least {1} days after you file it.
k:HH.Ins.Cancel.When.Special: Special cancellation: this is effective immediately, because of a settled claim or a premium increase.
k:HH.Ins.Cancel.Bundle: Leaving raises your other premiums by {0}. {1}
k:HH.Ins.Cancel.Bundle.Future: The bundle discount drops from now on, not backwards.
k:HH.Ins.Cancel.Bundle.Retro: The discount of the running quadrum will be recalculated and charged.
k:HH.Ins.Cancel.FormNote: Cancellations need Form C-7. Occasionally one comes back. {0}
k:HH.Ins.Cancel.Owed: Open claw-back on this policy: {0}. It will be settled in the final account.
k:HH.Ins.Cancel.Filed: Your cancellation is filed. It will be effective in {0}. We are sorry to see you go and will try to see you again.
k:HH.Ins.Cancel.Special: Special cancellation filed. The policy ends now.
k:HH.Ins.Cancel.FormErrorSoft: Your Form C-7 came back with a form error. We re-filed it for you, so your deadline is safe. You are welcome.
k:HH.Ins.Cancel.FormErrorHard: Your Form C-7 came back with an error (ink colour). The deadline was missed and slips by one quadrum. We have no further comment.
k:HH.Ins.Retention.Title: Before you go
k:HH.Ins.Retention.Body: We are sad to see {0} go. What if we made it {1} cheaper for {2} quadrums? Honest offer, no strings. (There are some strings. They are quite thin.)
k:HH.Ins.Retention.Body2: That was a good offer. This one is better: {1} off {0} for {2} quadrums. Please do not think of it as a trap.
k:HH.Ins.Retention.Body3: I have been passed your file. {0} for {1} off, {2} quadrums. I will personally forward your cancellation to a colleague who is on holiday.
k:HH.Ins.Retention.MinTerm: Discount means a new minimum term: you cannot leave until it is over.
k:HH.Ins.Retention.Still: No thanks, I still want to cancel
k:HH.Ins.Retention.Kept: Welcome back. Your discount is {0} for {1} quadrums.
k:HH.Ins.UI.NoGame: Clawback Mutual is closed outside a game.
k:HH.Ins.UI.Footer: Insurance is a promise. We keep the part that is in writing.
k:HH.Ins.UI.Bundle.Title: Bundle:
k:HH.Ins.UI.Bundle.None: Your first policy is the hardest. The third gives 10 % off all of them.
k:HH.Ins.UI.Bundle.Some: {0} active policies, {1} off. The third gives {2}.
k:HH.Ins.UI.Mech.Property: Own share {0}, pays {1} of the value.
k:HH.Ins.UI.Mech.Person: From {0} % invalidity, up to {1} of the sum.
k:HH.Ins.UI.Fine.Tail: The full terms are the 400 pages mentioned in our slogan. See also the Fine print tab.
k:HH.Ins.UI.Mine.None: You have no policy yet. It is the one thing we are sure about.
k:HH.Ins.UI.Mine.Foot: Policies renew automatically (clause 31). Special cancellation: after a settled claim or a premium increase you can leave within five days, immediately.
k:HH.Ins.UI.Debt: You owe Clawback Mutual {0} from clause 22.
k:HH.Ins.UI.Debt.Cannot: You cannot pay that right now.
k:HH.Ins.UI.Claims.None: No claims. Clawback Mutual is delighted and a little suspicious.
k:HH.Ins.UI.Fine.Title: The fine print
k:HH.Ins.UI.Fine.Lead: Fifteen clauses, as printed. From a certain level of sales pressure they are shown only as references. Clauses in grey are not active on your difficulty.
k:HH.Ins.UI.Limbs.Title: Schedule of Limbs
k:HH.Ins.UI.Limbs.Lead: Values in percent of the basic sum, per side. A lost part counts its value and replaces the values of its children; several parts add up to at most 100 %.
d:Silverline.SL_ClauseDef/SL_Clause_1.de: Cover begins after the waiting period.
d:Silverline.SL_ClauseDef/SL_Clause_4.de: Weather damage is a grey zone.
d:Silverline.SL_ClauseDef/SL_Clause_7b.d: Sieges and mechanoid clusters are a grey zone.
d:Silverline.SL_ClauseDef/SL_Clause_9.de: Damage that was there before is deducted.
d:Silverline.SL_ClauseDef/SL_Clause_11.d: Damage done by your own people is excluded.
A broken door is a grey zone.
d:Silverline.SL_ClauseDef/SL_Clause_17.d: One more day of review. From Overbooked a grey zone.
d:Silverline.SL_ClauseDef/SL_Clause_22.d: If a lost part grows back, so does the claim.
d:Silverline.SL_ClauseDef/SL_Clause_23.d: Dying before the assessment ends the assessment.
d:Silverline.SL_ClauseDef/SL_Clause_30.d: Cancellations can come back with a form error.
d:Silverline.SL_ClauseDef/SL_Clause_40.d: From Overbooked, Legal Shield does not help against Clawback Mutual.
d:Silverline.SL_LimbScheduleDef/SL_LimbS: The standard schedule (Anhang B.2) is built in. Add lines for modded body parts here.
d:Silverline.SL_PolicyDef/SL_ActsOfStory: Pays for buildings destroyed by raiders, mechanoids and the occasional misunderstanding with a siege engine. Not valid for fires, weather or you.
d:Silverline.SL_PolicyDef/SL_MuffaloMach: For things that move or fly: shuttles, drop pods and vehicles that are destroyed by an enemy.
Wheels, rotors and a very thorough form.
d:Silverline.SL_PolicyDef/SL_RoofOverHea: Fire, explosions and lightning. The fire has to be somebody else's, though.
Warm walls, cold comfort, quarterly premiums.
d:Silverline.SL_PolicyDef/SL_ItWasntMe.d: For damage to guests, traders and their goods, caused in your care and definitely not by you.
d:Silverline.SL_PolicyDef/SL_ItWasntMe.s: Somebody has to pay. Preferably us, for a fee.
d:Silverline.SL_PolicyDef/SL_LegalShield: Kanzlei Brix & Partners pay your fines and argue with the people who issued them. Also helps against Clawback Mutual, as long as nobody reads clause 40.
d:Silverline.SL_PolicyDef/SL_RimHealth.d: A flat sum for every colonist who spends a day in a sickbed.
d:Silverline.SL_PolicyDef/SL_RimHealth.s: Get well soon. Or at least get well quarterly.
d:Silverline.SL_PolicyDef/SL_GoldenYears: A pension for colonists who made it to sixty. The premium is cheap while they are young, which is the point.
Retire early. Then late. Then quarterly.
d:Silverline.SL_PolicyDef/SL_BlightBeGon: Cold snaps and toxic fallout eat crops. This eats the loss.
d:Silverline.SL_PolicyDef/SL_ClosedForRe: When your business has to close, the income does not.
Out of order is not out of premium.
d:Silverline.SL_PolicyDef/SL_Unspeakable: For damage the policy wording cannot describe without a lawyer in the room.
Some things are better insured than named.
For caravans: an insurance that is there when you are not. Billed by the head and the travel day, only while people are on the road.
Wish you were here. We'll cover the part where you are not.
Every limb has a price. We wrote it down. It is on the last page, in the Schedule of Limbs.
Every limb has a price. We wrote it down.
d:ResearchProjectDef/SL_Insurance.label: insurance
d:ResearchProjectDef/SL_Insurance.descri: A policy for every misfortune, sold by a mutual that has never lost an argument. Unlocks the insurance office and the policies of the basic cover levels "Bare Minimum" and "Good Enough".
d:ResearchProjectDef/SL_Actuarial.label: actuarial science
d:ResearchProjectDef/SL_Actuarial.descri: Tables of how likely everything is to go wrong, and what that is worth. Unlocks the top cover level "Premium of Premium", the premium policies and the services of the mutual.
